subject: Continuity acceptance criteria and restore samples for SIG/CAIQ review
messages:
From: Sara Malik <sara@talerahealth.com>
To: olga@redwoodai.com
Cc: Tom Reeves <treeves@spintech.io>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Continuity acceptance criteria & RTO/RPO sample request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our SIG/CAIQ and SOC2 readiness review we need a short set of artifacts that show your operational acceptance criteria for failover, and a sample of restore traces that demonstrate your RTO/RPO claims for the past 90 days. Specifically, could you provide:  

- A short description (2–3 bullets) of what constitutes an "acceptable" restore (warm-cache, data integrity checks, timestamped confirmation).
- A machine-readable RPO snapshot (CSV is fine) from a recent test or production restore.
- A 2–3 minute screen recording or trace excerpt showing a restore run (sanitized).
- Proposed witness windows (2-hour blocks) for a live witness or tabletop next week.

We will be sharing this with our procurement and security team; if anything is sensitive we can take it via a secure shared folder. We also have a short CAIQ crosswalk (one page) we can send to help map artifacts to questions.

Thanks,
Sara Malik
Security Manager, Talera Health
[sara@talerahealth.com]

--
Note: Tom from SpinTech will be joining the SIG intake call; CC'd above.

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwoodai.com>
To: Sara Malik <sara@talerahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodai.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Continuity acceptance criteria & RTO/RPO sample request

Sara — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a short runbook extract and an RPO snapshot from our last scheduled restore test (June 24). We redacted any IP addresses and customer identifiers per our data policy. Links/attachments below: runbook-extract-ops.pdf, rpo-snapshot-20260624.csv.

Acceptance criteria (high level):
- Warm-cache restored within target window and served verification traffic within RTO SLA (default: 3m for small jobs, 2h for full cluster fallback).
- KV cache consistency verified by checksum and end-to-end sample query comparison (post-restore).
- No data loss beyond declared RPO window (we measure from last committed snapshot).

Proposed witness windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-06-30 08:00–10:00
- Wed 2026-07-01 13:00–15:00

We can provide a short screen-capture of the restore trace; Marissa can produce a 2–3 minute clip with sanitized logs (we keep browser/console markers only). David is on-call for any infra questions during the witness.

If that works, I will also upload a short CAIQ crosswalk mapping these artifacts to the relevant sections and a Drive link for the secure folder.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
olga@redwoodai.com

Attachments: runbook-extract-ops.pdf, rpo-snapshot-20260624.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Sara Malik <sara@talerahealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwoodai.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Continuity acceptance criteria & RTO/RPO sample request

Sara / Olga — I produced the restore trace clip and uploaded it to the shared folder (restore-trace-clip.mp4). A few operational notes you can include in the SIG mapping:  

- The recorded trace is from a scheduled restore on 2026-06-24 at 02:18 PDT. It shows the recovery coordinator rehydrating the KV cache, running checksum verification, and executing an automated smoke test (3 synthetic queries).
- RPO snapshot columns: test_id, start_time_utc, last_commit_time_utc, rpo_seconds, outcome. We provide a 90-day rolling export for audits.
- For live witnesses we can scope a partial restore (non-prod namespace) to avoid customer data exposure; the sequence and timings are identical.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefGHIjk-restore-examples (read-only, expiring link).
DocRequest: If you need a notarized attestation for procurement, we can generate a short statement and route it through Legal; please let me know the required recipient and format.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Reliability Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodai.com

Attachments referenced: restore-trace-clip.mp4 (in Drive), runbook-extract-ops.pdf (attached earlier), rpo-snapshot-20260624.csv

From: Sara Malik <sara@talerahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, Tom Reeves <treeves@spintech.io>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Continuity acceptance criteria & RTO/RPO sample request

Olga / Marissa — thanks, this is very helpful. We reviewed the snapshot and the short clip; the procurement/security teams want to:  

1) Confirm a witness window for a live tabletop on Tue 2026-06-30 08:00–10:00 PDT (we prefer Tue if that slot is still available).
2) Ask for a 1-page CAIQ crosswalk that maps the attached artifacts to SIG domain questions (A.11, A.14, continuity categories). If you can drop that in the same Drive folder before the witness, that will speed sign-off.
3) For procurement we will request a signed acceptance letter to confirm the RPO/RTO definitions for the SOW (simple one-paragraph statement). Please let Legal know the recipient: contracts@talerahealth.com.

Tom — can you confirm you’ll join the tabletop for the SIG panel?

If all good, I’ll send calendar invites and an access token for the read-only Drive folder.

Best,
Sara Malik
Security Manager, Talera Health

--
